supporting_observations.claim: WS-EBROOKS-01 made repeated connections to PROXY-BLU-01 on port 8080; observed connections from 13:38 to 14:04 are spaced roughly four to six minutes apart.
Further connections to the proxy occurred at 14:09 and 14:13, followed by several connections close together around 14:17; this is not a uniformly five-minute pattern across the full review period.

The early connection cadence is compatible with the inventory-listed StockPilot updater's roughly five-minute update checks, but the available records do not identify StockPilot or any other process as the source.

The listed network records show connections to the explicit proxy over port 8080 with service reported as HTTP; by themselves, they do not establish the HTTPS destination or the content of any tunneled traffic.
